lixpiValue: user-selected from three fixed sizes plus auto
summary: Output dimensions. The matrix rewrites each pixel size into an aspect-ratio label, so 1536x1024 shows as 3:2.
combines: gpt-image-2 accepts arbitrary WIDTHxHEIGHT: both sides divisible by 16, ratio between 1:3 and 3:1, maximum 3840x2160, experimental above 2560x1440.
Our matrix hands gpt-image-2 the same three fixed sizes as every other model, so that capability is unreachable.

usage.setIn: services/api/src/llm/providers/openai-provider.ts:604 and :613 (also :250 and :504 on the tool-call paths)
usage.from: state.imageSize from the matrix control, falling back to 'auto'
usage.what: Output dimensions. The matrix shows these as aspect-ratio labels via mapResolutionOptionsToAspectRatioLabels, so the user picks a shape and the pixel size rides along.

note: For widthxheight when selected additional input must be rendered that allows to set that value
